critical_code_review_comments: EgyptTileRow.jsx: on unmount, useEffect returns { el.removeEventListener(...) } capturing ref.current which may be null between renders; consider capturing el = ref.current inside effect to avoid a potential runtime error if the row unmounts before ref settles. Non-blocking today.
EgyptPlanner.jsx: uses fixed h-[702px] and absolute positioning at lg+; safe for current data but any additional counter row would overflow the fixed height card.
EgyptHero StickyTabs: scroll threshold hardcoded at 560px; may not align with hero height at some breakpoints, but currently visually correct at 1440.
